verified_discovery_metadata.identity_rule: The Barkhaa programme/index is one collection identity; story/language audio objects are constituent manifestations/items and must not be inflated into independent source identities without item-level provenance.
verified_discovery_metadata.scope_rule: Only links explicitly labelled Mundari or Mundari-Mix are candidates for the Mundari stream. Other language versions are contextual manifestations, not Mundari evidence.
